Saudi Basic Industries Corp Names New Executive Vice President for Strategy

Saudi Basic Industries Corp, a leading player in the Kingdom’s chemicals industry, announced on Monday the appointment of Dr. Fahad Al-Shehri as Executive Vice President for Strategy, effective July 1. The move underscores the company’s focus on strengthening its long-term growth plans amid evolving global market dynamics.

Dr. Al-Shehri, who previously served as Chief Strategy Officer at Gulf Petrochem Industries, brings over two decades of experience in the chemicals and industrial sectors. His appointment follows the retirement of Abdulrahman Al-Mutairi, who held the post since 2018.

In a statement, CEO Yousif Al-Harbi welcomed Dr. Al-Shehri, citing his “deep understanding of global supply chains and proven track record in steering transformation projects.” Al-Harbi added, “We are confident that his vision will be instrumental as we continue to expand our international portfolio and drive operational excellence.”

Industry analysts have noted that the chemicals sector in Saudi Arabia is seeing a renewed focus on sustainability and downstream diversification. “Strategic leadership is crucial for companies navigating the region’s ambitious industrial agenda,” said Layla Al-Dosari, senior analyst at Riyadh Economic Forum.

The company reported annual revenues of SAR 150 billion in its latest financial statement, and has signaled intentions to invest further in research and development as well as circular economy initiatives.

The Saudi Chemical Manufacturers Association welcomed the appointment, with Secretary General Majed Al-Qahtani calling it “a positive step that reinforces the sector’s commitment to innovation and global competitiveness.”
